resources.funding_watch: The FY2026 President's Budget proposed ELIMINATING LIHEAP entirely (~$4B); Congress instead funded it at $4.045B for FY2026 (+$20M), so the season just ended was funded. HOWEVER: HHS terminated the ENTIRE federal LIHEAP program staff on 2025-04-01, leaving states running it without federal guidance, and LIHEAP faces elimination again in the FY2027 budget - the season opening this November. Colorado received ~$42M in FY2025.
